purpose: Live city parcel qualification with unmodified responses through the repository adapter; IDs and hashes retained, full geometries confined to temporary audit cache except three public samples.
sourceScope: Hulhumalé partial city coverage only; this 13-cell sample does not establish Malé-island or full Malé City coverage.

statusFilterAudit.statusMeaning: Layer metadata names the field domain Lots.DevelopmentStatus; it is a development status, not a parcel lifecycle/current-record flag.
statusFilterAudit.archiveMetadata: isDataArchived=true and supportsQueryWithHistoricMoment=true; the qualification used the service default current view and did not request a historic moment.
statusFilterAudit.reason: No official active/inactive parcel lifecycle field or definitionExpression is documented. A targeted exact OID adapter read of the material-overlap pair found one Completed status and one null status; excluding null would be unsupported and would not resolve provider lifecycle truth.

qualityConclusion: One sliver-like overlap and one material near-total containment: two polygons overlap by about 2445.58 m², approximately 100% of the smaller polygon. No geometries repaired. This material pair has only about 0.00185 m² symmetric difference and is flagged for source-level review.
